rulesTestNames: lets a guest get and list only their own contact permissions
lets only the guest read their event-day consent document (#2494)
owner: messaging contact permission writer, called in the same transaction by every consent writer
read: the guest gets and lists only their own documents by path while their account is not deleted; no organiser reads them directly, organisers get counts and audiences through the server's senderId + granted collection-group query
write: server only; written in the transaction of every consent decision (registration, follow by phone, form submission and promotion, inbound STOP, withdrawal, event-day preferences and withdrawal links, approval-notification choices), deleted at account deletion and, for event documents, by TTL after expiresAt
migrationNotes: Issue #2460. One document per sender and person, the only record of contact consent since step 3 retired catchCommunicationPreferences, organizerCommunicationPreferences and their two receipt collections. Each channel:purpose answer names the receipt that proves it and, for an opt-in, the number it covers; granted lists the effective keys.
The contact-permissions migration in tool/data/migrate_firestore_consolidation.mjs converted the data recorded before the writers (prod and dev held none).

Issue #2494 phase 2 step 1. Event documents, event_{eventId}, hold each guest's event-day sms, rcs and whatsapp grants (one per channel per event, bound to one roster row, one sender identity and one number until expiresAt) and their approval-notification choices (phone:bookingUpdates, email:bookingUpdates). The six event-day preference and withdrawal stores and manageEventApprovalNotifications write them in the transaction that still writes eventAssistancePermissions and eventApprovalNotificationPreferences; the send gates and the approval gate read only them. expiresAt is the TTL field. The contact-permissions-events migration in tool/data/migrate_firestore_consolidation.mjs builds them from the old collections.
